# truenas_cloudsync_run (Action)

Runs a cloud sync task now (cloudsync.sync).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run a cloud sync task now (Terraform 1.14+).
# id is the numeric task id — reference the managing resource rather than
# hardcoding it (or discover it with `midclt call cloudsync.query`).
action "truenas_cloudsync_run" "example" {
  config {
    id = truenas_cloudsync_task.offsite.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Cloud sync task id (truenas_cloudsync_task.<name>.id).

### Optional

- `wait` (Boolean) Wait for the job to finish (default true). Set false to start it and return immediately without polling.
